title: [Bug Fix] #638815: Subcontracting: actionable error for blank Subc. Location Code on WIP transfers
summary: The subcontracting transfer order report now raises a clear validation error when the subcontractor has no Subc. Location Code configured for WIP transfers, instead of showing a generic unhelpful message.
key_points: Replaces a silent exit with a TestField error on the vendor's blank Subc. Location Code in the WIP transfer path
WIP transfer path now validates the location code the same way the components path does
Users see an actionable misconfiguration error instead of the generic 'Nothing to create' message
Regression test added to the WIP transfer create test codeunit
